Apache-2.0; copied Empty presentation for the shared private log-canvas spacer. Workspace commands/drop authority omitted; resize-specific icon and text adapted. Exact source revision and hashes are in desktop-layout-sources.json.

Retain source Preview/Source/Blame outlined text ButtonGroup and icons; omit working-copy/edit mutations, use the same controlled display and inline Blame content seam; add public shadcn tooltips and shared owned action wrapper for hover feedback.

Preserve AppShell Body.Sidebar, resize handle and Body.Content topology inside the existing RepositoryShell; replace application route/admission/store/storage with a subscribed pinned read-only controller, typed host callbacks, optional inspector and layout callback; retain 256px default and 208-420px resize range.

Retain breadcrumb hierarchy and original store-application breadcrumb geometry; replace application router with canonical-path callbacks and optional repository callback; expose audited padding/font tokens.
Retain public FileListing modes and metadata slot; remove application-private icon resolver, add shared icon-bearing Empty and loading Skeleton; canonical host paths remain selection identities.

Retain summary, table and landing document composition; supplied entries replace view/routes/native reads, public shared avatar/identifiers/time replace local wrappers; PanelToggle replaces app-specific sidebar icon; optional host controls/row actions and explicit bounded/retry states replace editing actions.

Retain original table virtualizer, measured rows, paging and arrow/home/end focus navigation; public FileTypeIcon/RelativeTime replace source wrappers; host supplies commit metadata and typed row actions.
Retain recorded path-change versus snapshot attribution and tooltip; replace source domain commit type with portable record and optional host commit action.
Retain README/document tab labels, overflow fitting and document layout; accept recorded file union, reuse public stock Markdown reader and optional host editing callback; no mutation transport.

Retain metadata, stats, file card and content header; remove working-copy editor and native file access; use public CodeBlock/Markdown, shared source icon toggle and typed host history/blame/path/custom actions with distinct binary/empty/unavailable/retry states; remove nested vertical ScrollArea and forced minimum heights per user review.
Retain metadata row, message and native IDs; public shared avatar/identifiers/time replace app wrappers; controlled public Design Core PanelToggle replaces app-specific sidebar icon.
Use stock public MarkdownContent fullWidth; replace app-specific references/services with host-supplied captured text and shared Empty for empty content.
Copy pure canonical directory/path/document classification helpers; no application transport dependencies.

Retain source layout geometry under repository-browser namespace; expose audited native spacing/type/background tokens; remove forced 28rem/18rem preview minimum heights so short files adapt to the available pane.
Retain source summary/table typography, widths, responsive containers and attribution styles; rename ownership namespace and expose source-default row/background/type tokens.
Retain source document tabs, header and content geometry under owned namespace and expose original document padding.
Retain source file tree/sidebar geometry under owned namespace with audited sizing/type tokens.
Retain source pointer/keyboard resize-handle geometry under owned namespace and source-default 256px width token.

Preserve the source snapshot Popover/Command View, kind filters, local search, selected icon, virtual rows and continuation; replace app RepositoryChoice with public immutable choices and typed host selection, use public Badge instead of community chip, and shared icon-bearing Empty/Skeleton with retry; expose source-default sizing tokens.
Preserve source measured virtual rows, paging and cursor/selection callbacks; remove app appearance-store subscription and retain public ResizeObserver measurement with owned selectors.

Extract the existing pointer-capture, keyboard and reset resize flow into one private shared sidebar control; parameterize side, bounds, default width and host callbacks. The right edge reverses pointer/arrow direction and preserves independent host width ownership.
Lift and adapt the source style block into a native owned stylesheet; source and destination fingerprints recorded in desktop-layout-sources.json.

Copy command cards/filter/search/virtual rows; use public Badge, Avatar and RelativeTime, exact remote-aware identities and typed host actions; use grid/row/cell semantics for interactive card contents; CSS extracted to a colocated file.
Retain source Empty icon/messages/geometry; render outside the command grid, retaining an empty controlled grid for accessible input ownership.
Retain working-copy card layout; separate button from author/time popovers; public Badge/Avatar/RelativeTime and portable presentation type.

Extract Branches composition only; public AppShell/ColumnCanvas and shared Revisions/Diff replace app-private components. Host-owned captured references, actions and optional persisted canvas. Loading/retry states use public shared primitives; omit unrelated evolution/agent/review contexts.
Retain 380/480/560px widths and source bounds/path levels; use existing closed Diff and 240px resize-spacer convention. Host injects persistence instead of app-local storage.

Adapt source reference-target selection/reset flow into read-only portable captured-reference controller; reuse HistoryController for immutable ancestry, paging and comparisons. Routes/notifications/admission/mutations remain host-owned.

Extract source command-card styles; remove Svelte global wrappers for native CSS, substitute audited semantic variables and retain source geometry. Row/gridcell accessibility composition retains outer card selection/hover. Unselected branch and working-copy cards use the theme body background (white in light mode). Branch badges use public outline variants and root style props to retain an opaque body fill and visible border across row hover, focus and selection.
Retain Bookmark presentation fields with explicit remote identity; combine RepositoryWorkingCopy fields from projects/repository-log.ts and typed pinned read-port/controller state.

Retain embedded AppShell, toolbar/canvas/footer; replace native links/setup/notifications/command dialogs with injected controller states and typed host callbacks. Navigation labels are Stacks and Workspace; other application routes remain host-owned.

Retain fixed leading column, scrolling adjacent lanes and per-origin diffs, widths and tail spacer. Extract canvas defaults; replace native branch command with the owned public picker and exact bookmark keys. Transfer/forge panels and drop handlers are deferred.
Retain tab navigation and right workspace controls through public Toolbar/Tabs/Select. Limit navigation to this presentation slice and delegate named workspace selection and custom actions to hosts.
Retain target history column/card, author/time/tags, selected files and history paging. Reuse the shared graph, avatars and scoped files; omit source-only drag/forge/actions.

Retain stack column header, stage/start-commit cards, grouped bookmarks and paging. Use public generic graph and host slots; commands request host handling without execution; transfer and forge controls are deferred.

Fold source bookmark header into the private card, retain branch selection, shared/alias tags, author/time and grouped graph/files. Replace application-only graph/forge/drag controls with public graph, scoped files and host snippets.

Retain source-bound lazy loading, cancellation, selected path and paging. Replace application notices with icon-bearing unavailable/retry states and source file wrapper with public FileListing. Preserve supplied counts instead of synthesizing hunk counts; expose host actions.
Retain fixed Unstaged header/body and selected file diff origin; use scoped shared files, generic navigation and host file actions; transfer controls deferred. Distinct column/list landmark names.

Retain adjacent per-origin column, path, close, lazy diff reads, hunk cards and context. Replace application diff preferences with shared unified/split/wrap controls, explicit host actions and icon-bearing states; omit transfer buttons.
Retain bookmark/card/title/stage spacing and semantic hover/selection; namespace workspace classes, split lane-only display rules, expose native variables. Omit transfer and forge styles.

Retain flex canvas, leading inset, footer/control alignment and trailing spacer; namespace own classes, expose shell variables, keep viewport mechanics owned by public primitives and omit transfer/application routes.
Extract unchanged Branches 320/260/520, Unstaged 330/260/520, lane/target 390/310/640 and diff 580/360/980 dimensions into a public host-persistence-aware factory.
Exact retained card selection mapping with SPDX notice.

Copy pill tab gaps, radius, active/hover fills and toolbar geometry; keep the two-view toolbar in AppShell and expose secondary typography. Application overflow/other view routes are outside this two-tab part.

Copy native range header, checkbox, assign action and hunk card composition. Use public FileDiff directly and exact unique accessible labels; omit unconnected drag attributes; hosts receive assignment intents rather than executing a transfer. Hunk CSS is moved from the owning diff part.
